items.rationale: Translating the police report is claim substantiation, excluded under 3.1.6 and 7.1.8(f). Not indemnified.
Working material raised alongside an excluded translation charge is excluded under 7.1.8(e) and (f).

A watch is a valuable under 4.2.2. After 7.1.9 limits it to an equivalent replacement (bought for about 7,000), the per-item sub-limit of EUR 2,500 still caps it. The parallel case 31 (2,900-3,110 for watch plus cash) suggests the EUR 150 deductible is not taken off at line level.
Means of payment taken away from the premises are capped at EUR 500 under 2.3.2 and 4.2.3. The roughly EUR 900 taken is therefore limited to 500.
The sunglasses were lost on a separate occasion without force, so they are excluded under 2.3.4(a) and are not an affected item.
Carriage and forwarding charges are excluded under 7.1.8(b).
